objective: Find the best-fitting eligible subscription and explain its price, value, benefits, and trade-offs; cheapest is not automatically best.

calculation.formula: 24-month new plan cost + eligible overlap costs + fees - finalized gift-card amount - matched streaming replacement value
calculation.baselineFormula: 24-month current mobile subscription cost; separately paid streaming is not added to this baseline

questionPurposes.peopleCount: Choose individual or family/group plans and calculate additional-user pricing.
questionPurposes.operators: Determine new-customer, same-operator, or mixed future gift-card value tiers for each target operator.
questionPurposes.bindingEnds: Check whether each person is inside the target operator's sales window and can order now.
questionPurposes.mobileUsage: Meet the customer's data need without making them overpay for unused data.
questionPurposes.currentPrice: Measure monthly and 24-month value against the customer's current mobile subscription cost.
questionPurposes.streaming: Deduct only customer-paid services that the target plan includes and can replace.
questionPurposes.travel: Prefer plans whose roaming data and local-call capabilities match the customer's stated travel use.
